chunks: And al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sukūnī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
“When you cast dust upon the deceased, then say: ‘In faith in You and affirmation of Your Prophet; this is what Allah and His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله have promised.’”

He said: “And Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said: ‘I heard the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say: Whoever casts dust upon a deceased person and says these words, Allah grants him a good deed for every particle.’”

key_terms.إِيمَانًا: an expression of faith in Allah in this burial rite
key_terms.التُّرَابَ: the soil or dust placed upon the grave
key_terms.تَصْدِيقًا: affirmation and belief in the truthfulness of the Prophet
key_terms.حَسَنَةً: a good deed or meritorious act
key_terms.ذَرَّةٍ: a minute particle, indicating abundance of reward
key_terms.نَبِيِّكَ: Your Prophet, referring to the Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What should be said when placing soil on the deceased during burial in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a recommended remembrance to be recited while placing dust upon the deceased during burial. It links the act to iman and affirmation of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and states a great reward for the one who says it, with a good deed granted for every particle of dust.
